author: reek
body: The camera pass of shadow mapping. It ray-casts the scene (three spheres on a checkered floor) from the camera, projects each hit into the light's orthographic frame, reads the stored depth from the shadow map buffer, and darkens the point if something nearer the light was recorded there -- a true shadow test, not a shadow ray. The light orbits with the frame; the basis matches ShadowMapKernel. Float math from DeviceMath.
